description: imagepeek: Upscale a small image 2x with a neural model. Returns creates a 2x neural derivative of one PNG, JPEG or WebP using offline QuickSRNet Small (BSD-3-Clause). Neural x2 derivative, not recovered detail or OCR. PNG/JPEG/WebP <=250000 pixels, 2048 per side; output PNG <=1 MP. EXIF oriented, alpha white, frame 0. Failures not charged.. Up to 45 s. Price: USD 0.01. No free tier.
